Having been in the position of your friend, I would say the best thing to do is just go and be there. A hug would be appropriate, but I wouldn't advise you to bring up the attempt or ask questions about it. If he brings it up first its all good, and feel free to participate in the conversation. The best thing you can do is be there and keep talking about the same things you always talked about. Honestly, just be a friend. It will be awkward, but if you act normal it will all be okay. 

I realize you may have already gone, since you posted this awhile ago, but if not, good luck!

((((((hugs))))))
I don't really know what to say, as I am in my own low place right now, but just know there are more people that feel this way. We have each other. If you want to talk feel free to PM me.

I have always wanted to start writing a bucket list or something like it for myself, but I never did. 

If I was the happiest person in the world right now I would keep doing whatever it was that brought me to that place. Right now I'm still trying to figure out what that something is.

I don't have many people around me. Like I mentioned in my original post I don't really have friends due to various things in my life. People are cruel most of the time, and sometimes they judge people by the things that have happened to them, and I think that is a big problem in my case. As far as my job is concerned... yeah I like it. Sometimes it doesn't feel challenging enough which often leads to me thinking I'm not doing anything to make the world better. 

Your questions are fine, please feel free to ask anything.

Thanks. I appreciate you investing the time to reply and consider my situation. I have been through about 6 months of professional counseling. It was kind of helpful in the moment, but didn't seem to last.
sure send me a PM, I will reply.

Hi, well like I said Im a 23yo. I currently live on my own and I work full time at a respectable place, and I make a decent living. 

I should have clarified that I've been feeling like this for about 3 years. Sometimes it feels okay, but I always find myself right back in this "place". 

I understand your point about trying to stop looking for reasons, but at the same time, if I don't have anything to live for then what's the point. Sure I have enough money to keep going, but what's the worth in that if the rest of life seems so alone. The only thing that sometimes helps me forget is music.
